items.text: Last week, I visited organizations focused on addressing nutrition assistance and food insecurity in #CA37. It painted a picture of the hunger crisis in LA and how vital programs like SNAP and WIC are for families in need. Read more in @thelasentinel: https://t.co/w64IFlb24H

Yesterday’s #NHAAD highlighted how HIV and AIDS have disproportionately affected our LGBTQI+ community, especially our senior members. With the @EqualityCaucus, I will continue to work to end the stigma and improve funding for testing & treatment. https://t.co/m32g0K1mez

On #NGMHAAD, I remain committed to stamping out harmful HIV stigma, and as a member of the @EqualityCaucus, I will continue to work with my colleagues to improve access to testing, treatment, and preventative medications like PrEP for men living with HIV. https://t.co/Sxu0cUWjTj

On #WorldAIDSDay, I stand with the @EqualityCaucus in renewing our fight to end the #HIVEpidemic and to honor those who’ve been lost. I will continue to support accessible testing and treatment options as we work to end the stigma. https://t.co/4StOJtqzoj

A record 21.3 million Americans have signed up for health insurance through Obamacare this year—and you can too. 

Visit https://t.co/vurWNWGNoO now to access lower premiums and affordable rates! Registration closes January 31. #CoveredCA  

https://t.co/yH11VNM4gW https://t.co/43ydPM21iD

The @LATimes has done invaluable reporting over the years, serving our democracy with essential coverage that has helped change & shape our communities for the better. The 115 layoffs - many people of color - is a loss that will be felt deeply across CA37. https://t.co/wgk8ExCt5F

Black women are more prone to uterine fibroids and suffer more severe symptoms than other women.

I’m cosponsoring the U-FIGHT Act to fund research and treatment that will help address these disparities.

House Democrats have fought hard to make health care more affordable by lowering prescription drug costs and cutting premiums.

But these are patchwork solutions. It’s time to ensure that everyone has access to the care they need through #MedicareForAll.

It’s been 2 years since Dobbs.

21 states have banned abortion. Many have criminalized patients & providers. 1 in 3 women now live in states where their reproductive freedom is under attack, placing burdens on states like CA.

We must act to ensure access to repro care for all. https://t.co/SVnQY6Btk0

The Voting Rights Act has helped millions exercise the sacred right to vote. 18 years ago today, it was extended, guaranteeing protections for the next 25 years.

As we celebrate this anniversary, let's look to the future and pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.

On the 59th anniversary of Medicare & Medicaid, let's not forget: while Democrats work to expand coverage & lower costs, the House GOP proposed higher premiums & drug prices for Medicare and $4.5 trillion in cuts to the ACA, Medicaid, & the Children’s Health Insurance Program.

Poll workers are a cornerstone of our election system—ensuring that every vote is counted accurately and that every voter can exercise their fundamental right without obstruction.

This National Poll Worker Recruitment Day, sign up to be a poll worker at https://t.co/lQFUHQaQWN! https://t.co/hfYGcfEgsl

Today, as we celebrate the Voting Rights Act, we’re reminded that the work of strengthening our democracy is never over.

Let’s pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act & Freedom to Vote Act to ensure all Americans have the ability to exercise their most sacred right.

Project 2025 threatens to make the Thurmans’ nightmare a reality for too many more families.

Amber Thurman should be raising her son and helping her patients today. In her name, we must work to restore and enhance reproductive care nationwide.

Don’t sleep on sports!

Hosting the World Cup, Olympics, and other major sporting events provides us an unparalleled opportunity to advance U.S. global leadership through sports diplomacy.

I’m glad to lead the effort in Congress to capitalize on the American decade of sports. https://t.co/xp1OQX8GjV

On Medicaid Day of Action, I hosted a roundtable with patients and providers to discuss the impacts of Republican healthcare cuts on CA-37, which ranks 4th in the nation for Medicaid enrollment.

Medicaid shouldn't be partisan—it helps people in both blue and red districts. We must continue to share our stories and tell the truth about this life-saving program.

House Republicans voted to defund food assistance for seniors in need by $20 million... during National Nutrition Month.

Allowing 25,000 seniors to go hungry is diabolical. I will keep fighting to protect the food assistance programs that keep our communities healthy & fed.

15 years ago, President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law, lowering healthcare costs for millions of Americans.

House Republicans just voted to increase ACA marketplace premiums by $2,020 a year.

The Affordable Care Act saves lives—I'll always fight to protect it. https://t.co/XkfVQ4LLJG

The numbers are in: Republicans' plan to cut $880 BILLION from Medicaid would reduce coverage for 8.6 million Americans and leave 3.9 million Americans uninsured.

That's not getting rid of "waste and fraud." It's ripping health care away from Americans, and it's downright evil.

I am deeply saddened to hear of President Biden’s diagnosis. My prayers are with the President, the First Lady, and the Biden family.

For over 50 years, President Biden fought hard for the American people. I know he will bring that same fighting spirit to this battle.

As AANHPI Heritage month comes to a close, I'm committed to supporting the AANHPI community in LA & across the U.S. 🌸 

It was great to sit down with local community leaders to discuss their issues like Medicaid, elder care, and immigration reforms, among others. https://t.co/SdUSCp0Jeg

Over 400K of my constituents rely on Medicaid.

Trump & Republicans' Medicaid cuts would reduce or cancel coverage for millions—forcing places like St. John's Avalon Health & Access Center to close.

I talked to @sjhealthca’s President & CEO about the ripple effect of these cuts. https://t.co/1I233OoP9M

$500 million in cuts to global health programs that help healthy newborns and new mothers…because that’s “pro life?”

(And OMB Director Vought—you would know that family planning and reproductive healthcare IMPROVES women’s lives, if you ever spoke to one) https://t.co/Gx5OGve4jV

Donald Trump is staging all of these provocations to distract from $880 billion in Medicaid cuts (and he and Elon's divorce without a prenup).
 
We want Trump out of our city. https://t.co/Q0HwoQ2VgH

Trump has manufactured chaos in Los Angeles to distract from him crippling our economy, cutting Medicaid, and tearing immigrant families apart.
 
We see right through this distraction. I stand with @CAgovernor, @MayorOfLA, and our city—get Trump out of LA! https://t.co/tr685Z3hVu
